artifacts.retention: Ignored and temporary artifacts may expire.

decision.after: The task, repository harness, and focused skill descriptions guide ordinary work. Hoyelam Mode is explicit-only and remains available when requested or adopted by a project.
decision.before: User-level, workspace, repository, and exercise instructions required Hoyelam Mode for non-trivial or all engineering work.
decision.reason: The broad mandate loaded general guidance before the model could determine whether it affected the task. Retaining explicit invocation preserves the preference bundle without making it a prerequisite.

actions: Returned a one-sentence summary with the project-local path.
Made no file changes and ran no product checks.

failures.error: The first fresh-session launch could not initialize the in-process app-server under the outer sandbox.
failures.resolution: Retried with elevated process startup while retaining the child workspace-write sandbox.

failures.error: The first explicit-invocation command passed an unsupported -a flag to codex exec.
failures.resolution: Removed the unsupported flag and retained the read-only child sandbox.

limitations: One synthetic documentation task does not establish behavior across repositories, models, or complex workflows.
The exercise confirms a correct direct path, not whether every focused skill will be selected when useful.
The running desktop conversation retains its startup catalog; fresh sessions observe the revised discovery policy.
Shared caches affect token usage, so the recorded usage is not a baseline comparison.

official_guidance.observation: OpenAI recommends focused skill triggers, progressive disclosure, and contextual AGENTS.md references because broad or over-emphasized instructions can load irrelevant guidance and consume context.

package_validation.observed: Validated 16 skills, 10 agents, and 3 automation packs; 74 tests passed with no failures or skips.
